label: Create Post
description: Create and publish or schedule a post to one or more social media platforms.

parameters.name: content
parameters.label: Content
parameters.help: Post text. Optional if using per-target content in target_options.

parameters.name: targets
parameters.label: Target Accounts
parameters.help: Account IDs (acc_*), platform names (twitter), or workspace IDs (ws_*). Use the List Accounts or List Workspaces RPC to find IDs.

parameters.name: scheduled_at
parameters.label: Schedule
parameters.help: "now" to publish immediately, "draft" to save as draft, or an ISO 8601 timestamp (e.g. 2025-01-15T09:00:00Z).

spec.name: mime_type
spec.label: MIME Type
spec.help: Authoritative MIME type when known, for example audio/mpeg

spec.name: duration_ms
spec.label: Duration (Milliseconds)
spec.help: Media duration in milliseconds. Required for TikTok video validation.

parameters.name: timezone
parameters.label: Timezone
parameters.help: IANA timezone (e.g. America/New_York). Only used with scheduled timestamps.

parameters.name: target_options
parameters.label: Target Options
parameters.help: A JSON object keyed by platform, account ID, or workspace ID. Examples: {"whatsapp":{"to":"15551234567"}}, {"snapchat":{"content_type":"saved_story"}}, or {"tiktok":{"privacy_level":"SELF_ONLY","allow_comment":true,"allow_duet":false,"allow_stitch":false,"brand_content_toggle":false,"brand_organic_toggle":false,"content_preview_confirmed":true,"express_consent_given":true}}. Make validates the JSON before sending it; RelayAPI requires the top level and every target value to be objects.
